scope: HAWKEYE Sterling AIMS: screening, entity risk, advisory and bounded agent tooling
applicability_policy: provisional_applicable; owner must review and justify any exclusions
interpretation: Document paths and enterprise-control status are NOT proof of active operations, supplier contract execution, internal audit, Board approval or certification.

controls.title: AI policy
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain the approved current policy and evidence of staff communication

controls.title: Alignment with other organisational policies
controls.operational_proof_required: Reconcile AI rules with approved privacy, AML and information-security policies

controls.title: Review of AI policy
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain a dated policy review and authorized change or no-change decision

controls.title: AI roles and responsibilities
controls.operational_proof_required: Obtain formal committee/Board ownership decisions and prove operating RACI

controls.title: Reporting of concerns
controls.operational_proof_required: Demonstrate an accessible concern channel and a dated triage and closure record

controls.title: Resource documentation
controls.operational_proof_required: Reconcile every in-scope AI resource and its current accountable owner

controls.title: Data resources
controls.operational_proof_required: Reconcile lawful data source, purpose, classification, quality and retention evidence

controls.title: Tooling resources
controls.operational_proof_required: Record versioned tool authorizations, usage restrictions and access reviews

controls.title: System and computing resources
controls.operational_proof_required: Reconcile compute capacity, access, recovery and protected infrastructure evidence

controls.title: Human resources
controls.operational_proof_required: Record actual named operator training, competence and second-operator readiness

controls.title: AI system impact assessment process
controls.operational_proof_required: Evidence the assessment method, triggers and appropriate independent review

controls.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain system/version-specific impact results and their recorded approvals

controls.title: Impact on individuals and groups
controls.operational_proof_required: Complete the first human-reviewed subgroup fairness and adverse-impact cycle

controls.title: Societal impacts of AI systems
controls.operational_proof_required: Revisit broader social, economic and environmental impacts with dated sign-off

controls.title: Objectives for responsible AI development
controls.operational_proof_required: Approve measurable safety, fairness and transparency objectives before material changes

controls.title: Processes for responsible AI design and development
controls.operational_proof_required: Show enforced lifecycle gates and human approval for material changes

controls.title: AI system requirements and specification
controls.operational_proof_required: Trace each approved AI use case to scoped requirements and acceptance criteria

controls.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain architecture, design decisions, threat analysis and version lineage

controls.title: AI system verification and validation
controls.operational_proof_required: Finish overdue model validation, live Advisor evaluation and human sign-off

controls.title: AI system deployment
controls.operational_proof_required: Preserve pre-release sign-off, configuration approval and rollback evidence

controls.title: AI system operation and monitoring
controls.operational_proof_required: Produce fresh live quality, security, bias and incident monitoring run evidence

controls.title: AI system technical documentation
controls.operational_proof_required: Version model limitations, uses, configurations and auditor documentation

controls.title: AI system recording of event logs
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain independently verifiable authorized event logs and retention access reviews

controls.title: Data for development and enhancement
controls.operational_proof_required: Show documented data requirements and approved uses for every in-scope AI asset

controls.title: Acquisition of data
controls.operational_proof_required: Prove lawful sourcing, selection, licenses and processor approvals

controls.title: Quality of data for AI systems
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain dated data quality measurements, fail-closed counters and bias review

controls.title: Data provenance
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain origin, transforms, source version and independently anchored lineage

controls.title: Data preparation
controls.operational_proof_required: Reconstruct normalization and preparation rules applied to a reviewed result

controls.title: System documentation and information for users
controls.operational_proof_required: Provide tested notices of intended use, limits and human review rights

controls.title: External reporting
controls.operational_proof_required: Verify actual reporting obligations, channel ownership and external-assurance decisions

controls.title: Communication of incidents
controls.operational_proof_required: Exercise notice recipients, legal clocks, independent alarms and dated outcomes

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.operational_proof_required: Record approved disclosures to each affected stakeholder category

controls.title: Processes for responsible AI use
controls.operational_proof_required: Prove operator acknowledgement, human review and documented treatment of above-appetite risks

controls.title: Objectives for responsible AI use
controls.operational_proof_required: Demonstrate measured responsible-use objectives and review of KRI breaches

controls.title: Intended use of the AI system
controls.operational_proof_required: Prove restricted intended use and human-only consequential decisions

controls.title: Allocation of AI-related responsibilities
controls.operational_proof_required: Retain signed responsibility allocation for vendor and customer processing

controls.title: Suppliers
controls.operational_proof_required: Verify DPAs, subprocessors, retention, location and independent supplier due diligence

controls.title: Customers
controls.operational_proof_required: Record customer AI obligations, transparency notices and agreed complaint channels
